Java List.of retains the duplicate (108-109); read()'s LinkedHashMap keeps the FIRST occurrence (228-237), so 'all' resolves at generic-goos priority, BEFORE amd64 — a dedup-to-first-position runner and a dedup-to-last runner disagree: this expects first.

The literal GOOS string 'unix' is NOT a member of IS_GOOS_UNIX (180-181 lists concrete OSes only), so the artificial-unix slot is ''. 'unix' still matches via the goos slot itself. A runner that emits 'unix' twice in arch_search_order, or shifts amd64 before the second unix, fails the order assertion.

Base parses and exists but retains zero applicable buckets: Java read() yields a NON-EMPTY snapshot whose isInvalid() is true (arches.isEmpty(), 503-505) — distinct from GoApiSnapshot.EMPTY. The status enum has no zero-match state (w1 D5 unresolved); this pins the current model's mapping to base_only with empty buckets, NOT missing_base and NOT an error.
